claims.evidence: Witness photos show a used engine assembly with bellhousing/gearbox area and hoses/pipes, but no readable make/model/engine code or transmission identification.
No readable drivetrain/transfer-case or VIN/label details in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Wrong engine/transmission compatibility (year/variant mismatch) for the buyer’s Jeep; bellhousing may look similar across variants but internal specs differ.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine/transmission ID tags/labels (casting numbers and/or VIN/part number stickers) and the transmission model code stamped on the case.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unverified used engine/gearbox assembly with unknown compatibility (worst-case: may not fit or may require swaps).

risks.risk: Engine may be incomplete (missing ECU, sensors, starter/alternator, turbo parts if applicable, injectors, radiator hoses, etc.).
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo showing all included components, plus close-ups of the ECU/sensors/injectors/starter/alternator ports and what is missing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: buyer must source missing parts).

risks.risk: Non-running or internal damage (cracks, bent parts, worn bearings) not visible from external assembly photos.
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine running (or at minimum a compression test report / leak-down test results) and any fault-code scan if it was connected.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven to run (worst-case: treated as for parts/repair).

risks.risk: Transmission condition unknown (shifting issues, worn clutch/flywheel, bad bearings) not detectable from static photos.
risks.proof: Video of transmission/transfer case operation (gear engagement) and photos of clutch/flywheel condition if included; also any diagnostic scan results.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as transmission condition unknown (worst-case: may need rebuild).

risks.risk: Overheating or prior damage history (warped components, coolant/oil contamination) not visible externally.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of coolant/oil passages, any discoloration/burn marks, and a report of overheating history; plus inspection of mating surfaces for warping.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case used condition with no history (worst-case: hidden damage).

proof_requests: Clear photos of engine and transmission casting numbers/ID tags (including any stickers/part numbers) and the transmission model code stamped on the case.
A photo/video showing the full assembly from multiple angles confirming completeness (ECU, starter, alternator, sensors, injectors, hoses, wiring harness ends).
Video of the engine starting/running (or compression/leak-down test results) and any fault-code scan if available.
Video showing transmission/transfer case engagement (gears/low range) and photos of clutch/flywheel condition if included.
response.reason: The witness confirms a used engine/gearbox assembly, but the seller’s specific Jeep Wrangler 3.6L (2011–2017) 4X4 compatibility and drivetrain details are not readable or verifiable from the provided photos. Without ID tags and running/compression proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
